Join the thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers behind tomorrow’s technology. As an Engineer Component Verification in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in? Your Role Key responsibilities in your new role Validating analog-mixed-signal microcontroller devices on manufactured hardware through investigating their electrical characteristics Setup of measurement equipment (hardware) and test program environment (software) for mixed-signal verification of respective expected functionality in a lab environment Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define reusable test concepts and automation, drive alignment via technical reviews, and integrate feedback Leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GPT/Copilot) test development and documentation; (big plus) building agentic workflows for test generation, execution, triage, and reporting Review existing characterization methodologies and introduce new approaches to improve coverage, robustness and reuse Leading and mentoring junior engineers and supervising students Your Profile Qualifications and skills to help you succeed A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Information and Communication Technology (or comparable) Several years of professional experience related to semiconductor test, characterization or product development/validation Strong programming skills (e.g., C/C++, Python, MATLAB or similar) with a focus on test/automation in lab environments Hands-on expertise in electrical measurements and lab test setup to ensure accurate, repeatable measurements Strong experience with Git-based development, PR-based collaboration and CI/CD Confident using LLM tools (GPT/Copilot) in day-to-day engineering; experience building agentic automation flows is a strong plus Nice to have: Exposure to automotive communication protocols and related transceivers; basic ability to support physical-layer and system debugging in the lab Fluent English skills required; German language skills are beneficial but not mandatory Contact: Felix Krackau #WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
